 Markets Closed for Diwali Balipratipada on Tuesday
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Nov 10, 2026 09:11
 x 
 Domestic equity, currency, and debt markets in India will remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, due to the Diwali Balipratipada festival. Key Points
 Indian markets will be closed on Tuesday, November 10.
 The closure is due to the Diwali Balipratipada festival.
 This affects domestic equity, currency, and debt markets.
 New Delhi, Nov 10 (PTI) Domestic equity, currency and debt markets will remain closed on Tuesday on account of "Diwali Balipratipada". PTI DRR
